title: Best time to ski in Val Thorens: 2026/27 dates, holidays and snow
metaTitle: Best time to ski in Val Thorens 2026/27 | SkiShare
description: Val Thorens is open from 21 November 2026 to 2 May 2027. Which weeks UK half-term, Easter and French holidays fill, when snow is deepest and prices lowest.
keywords: best time to ski val thorens
intro: Val Thorens is open from 21 November 2026 to 2 May 2027, and the linked 3 Vallées from 5 December to 18 April. For quieter slopes with everything open, pick a week outside the school holidays: 12–19 December, 9 January to 6 February or 6–20 March. Holidays pile up at Christmas and from 13 to 27 February, when UK half-term, Dutch and Belgian breaks and two French zones overlap; in our apartments those February weeks cost about three times a week in late November or April. Snow at Météo-France's village station is deepest from February to April, 140–152 cm on average.

sections.heading: When does Val Thorens open in 2026/27?
paragraphs: Val Thorens and Orelle open on Saturday 21 November 2026 and close on Sunday 2 May 2027, according to SETAM, which runs the lifts; the rest of the 3 Vallées, 600 km of pistes in all, is linked from 5 December 2026 to 18 April 2027.

sections.heading: When is February half-term 2027? School holidays by country
paragraphs: In England, February half-term 2027 is 15–19 February in the councils we checked (Surrey, Southwark in London, Plymouth), and Edinburgh's break falls on the same days. Councils set their own dates and academies can differ: [GOV.UK](https://www.gov.uk/school-term-holiday-dates) sends parents to their council's website.

after: **France:** holidays begin after Saturday classes and end on the Sunday before classes resume. Zone A includes the académies of Lyon, Grenoble and Bordeaux, zone B those of Lille, Nantes, Strasbourg and Aix-Marseille, and zone C those of Paris, Créteil, Versailles, Montpellier and Toulouse.

**The Netherlands:** the February dates are the ministry's advice, which schools may change, for example to match carnival. The north includes Noord-Holland, the centre Zuid-Holland and most of Utrecht, and the south Limburg, Zeeland and most of Noord-Brabant.

sections.heading: Which weeks are busiest and cheapest? Prices for every Saturday
paragraphs: Holidays bunch up from 21 December to 1 January, when every calendar above is off, and from 13 to 27 February, when two French zones overlap with UK, Dutch or Belgian pupils. In our agency apartments, the weeks of 13 and 20 February cost about three times a week in late November or April, New Year week more than twice and Christmas week about one and a half times (as of 23 October 2026).

The cheapest weeks are late November, 12 December and 27 March to the end of April; 2 and 9 January cost less than the rest of January. The table shows the cheapest agency apartment still free for each Saturday-to-Saturday week, and how many are free; click a Saturday to see them.

sections.heading: Late November and early December: cheaper, not all open
paragraphs: Late November and early December are among the cheapest weeks, with no school holidays, but only Val Thorens and Orelle are open until 5 December, and early-season snow varies most from year to year. From 12 December every 3 Vallées sector is open, and passes keep the lower price until 18 December.

At Météo-France's village station (2,277 m), average snow depth over the last seven winters ranged from 4 cm (2020) to 38 cm (2023) in November and from 37 to 115 cm in December, yet every December day had snow on the ground. ESF Val Thorens starts children's group lessons on 6 December (ages 3–4) and 7 December (from 5).
after: A good compromise: [12–19 December](/en/apartments?checkin=2026-12-12&checkout=2026-12-19), with everything open, no school holidays and a Sunday-to-Friday pass at the lower price.

sections.heading: Christmas and New Year in Val Thorens
paragraphs: From 21 December to 1 January, schools in every country in the table above are on holiday, the only time of the season they all are. France's holidays run from 19 December to 3 January, and the British, Dutch and Belgian schools in the table go back between 4 and 6 January. Main-season pass prices apply from 19 December.

In our apartments, New Year week (26 December) costs more than twice a late-November week and Christmas week about one and a half times; the week of 2 January, as schools go back, costs much less. Expect cold: December's average low is −7.4°C and its average high 0.1°C, with 14 days that stay at or below zero.

sections.heading: Val Thorens in January
paragraphs: January has the longest stretch without school holidays: none of the calendars above has one from 11 January to 5 February. It is also the coldest month at the village station, with an average low of −10.3°C, an average high of −2.1°C and 20 days that stay at or below zero; the coldest reading of the last eight winters was −21.6°C, on 11 January 2019.

The snow is settled: 113 cm on average in January, and more than 30 cm every day from January to April in all seven winters. In our apartments, 2 and 9 January cost less than the rest of the month. A quiet week: [9–16 January](/en/apartments?checkin=2027-01-09&checkout=2027-01-16); month by month: [Val Thorens weather and snow](/en/guide/val-thorens-weather-and-snow).

sections.heading: February 2027: half-term and the French holidays
paragraphs: From 6 February to 7 March at least one French zone is on holiday, and most other breaks in the table fall in the middle two weeks. Saturday to Saturday:
list: **6–13 February:** French zone C (including Paris) and Flanders (8–14 February).
**13–20 February:** English half-term, Edinburgh, Copenhagen and Gothenburg (15–19 February), the southern Netherlands, French zones A and C.
**20–27 February:** French zones A and B, the northern and central Netherlands, French-speaking Belgium (from 22 February) and Oslo.
**27 February – 6 March:** French zone B and French-speaking Belgium (to 5 March).
after: In our apartments, 13 and 20 February are the dearest weeks of the season; 27 February costs less and 6 March, as zone B goes home, less again. The village station averages 140 cm of snow in February, the driest month of the season, with 7 days of at least 1 mm of rain or snow against 12 in December.

sections.heading: Val Thorens in March
paragraphs: March has the deepest average snow at the village station, 152 cm, and from 8 to 21 March none of the calendars above has a holiday; Oslo's and Copenhagen's Easter breaks start on 22 March, England's on Good Friday, 26 March. Daily highs average 2.0°C, but lows are still −8.0°C, as in February.
In our apartments, March costs less than the February holidays but more than April. A week between the holidays: [13–20 March](/en/apartments?checkin=2027-03-13&checkout=2027-03-20).

sections.heading: April and Easter 2027 in Val Thorens
paragraphs: Easter Sunday is 28 March 2027: the English and Flemish Easter holidays fill the weeks of 27 March and 3 April, Edinburgh's run from 5 to 19 April, and France's spring holidays follow zone by zone from 3 April to 2 May. The rest of the 3 Vallées closes on 18 April, with cheaper passes from 10 April; then only Val Thorens and Orelle, 150 km of pistes according to SETAM, stay open until 2 May.

The village station averaged 143 cm of snow in April, with more than 30 cm every April day in all seven winters. Spring snow is usually firm in the morning after a frost, which came on 26 of April's 30 days on average, and softer by midday, when the average high is 4.4°C.

The last week, from 24 April, brings French zone B, the Dutch May holiday (24 April – 2 May) and French-speaking Belgium (from 26 April); ESF's crèche closes for renovation from that week, and its Piou-Piou lessons for 3-year-olds are not offered then. In our apartments, every week from 27 March to the end of April costs about as much as late November.

faqs.q: When does Val Thorens open in 2026?
faqs.a: Val Thorens and Orelle open on Saturday 21 November 2026 and close on Sunday 2 May 2027; the whole 3 Vallées is linked from 5 December 2026 to 18 April 2027.

Each English council sets its own dates; in Surrey, Southwark and Plymouth it is 15–19 February 2027, the same days as Edinburgh's break. In Val Thorens that is the Saturday-to-Saturday week from 13 February.

faqs.q: When are the French February holidays in 2027?
faqs.a: Zone C (including Paris) is off from 6 to 21 February 2027, zone A (including Lyon) from 13 to 28 February and zone B (including Lille) from 20 February to 7 March.

faqs.q: Is January a good time to ski in Val Thorens?
faqs.a: For quieter slopes, yes: none of the French, Belgian, Dutch, UK or Scandinavian calendars we checked has a school holiday from 11 January to 5 February. It is the coldest month, with an average low of −10.3°C at the village station.

faqs.q: Is Val Thorens busy at Easter 2027?
faqs.a: Easter Sunday is 28 March 2027. English and Flemish Easter holidays fill the weeks of 27 March and 3 April, and France's spring holidays run zone by zone from 3 April to 2 May.

faqs.q: When is the snow deepest in Val Thorens?
faqs.a: At Météo-France's village station, from February to April: 140 to 152 cm on average over the winters 2019/20 to 2025/26. These are past averages, so check the snow report before you go.

faqs.q: Can you ski in Val Thorens at the end of April?
faqs.a: Yes: Val Thorens and Orelle stay open until 2 May 2027, with 150 km of pistes according to SETAM, but the rest of the 3 Vallées closes on 18 April.
